What We Offer

Our Services

Comprehensive property maintenance across North Wales — from emergency roof repairs to complete garden transformations.

Roofing Work And Repairs

Professional replacement and repair. Traditional and modern techniques for all roof types and needs. Chimney repairs and removals.

  • New installations
  • Tile replacement & repairs
  • dry and traditional verge, hip and ridge systems
  • Lead work & flashings

Flat Roofs

Specialist flat roof installation and repair using modern materials built to last. EPDM, felt and GRP solutions.

  • EPDM rubber roofing
  • GRP fibreglass systems
  • Felt & torched systems
  • Flat roof conversions

Storm Damage Repairs

24-hour emergency call-out for storm damage. Rapid response to protect your property and prevent further damage.

  • 24hr emergency call-out
  • Insurance work undertaken
  • Temporary weatherproofing
  • Full damage assessment

Fencing

Supply and installation of all fence types. From timber panels to concrete posts — secure, stylish boundary solutions.

  • Timber panel fencing
  • Concrete post & gravel board installations
  • Close board fencing
  • Fence repairs

Roof And Gutter Cleaning

Professional moss and algae removal to extend your roof's lifespan and restore its appearance. Biocide treatments included.

  • Moss & lichen removal
  • Biocide treatment
  • Gutter cleaning and unblocking
  • Repairs and re-sealing

Facias, Soffits And Gutters

Professionally installed fascias, soffits, and guttering designed to protect your property while improving its appearance and durability. We provide high-quality, low-maintenance installations with a clean, reliable finish built to withstand the North Wales weather.

  • Low maintenance
  • Upvc and timber
  • High quality materials
  • Cladding installed

Patios , Paths and Decking

Beautiful patios and pathways in natural stone, porcelain and concrete, decking in composite and treated timber to suit all needs.

  • Natural stone patios
  • Concrete and aggregate paths
  • Timber and composite materials
  • Staining on timber service

Outdoor Space Transformations

We can completely transform overgrown or uneven ground into beautiful usable spaces that you can enjoy. Full ground preparation, levelling and laying for a perfect finish.

  • Overgrowth removed
  • Ground preparation
  • Levelling & grading
  • Aftercare advice

Artificial Grass

Low-maintenance artificial grass installation. Perfect for families, pets and anyone wanting a year-round green garden.

  • Premium artificial turf
  • Full base preparation
  • Edging & joining
  • Low maintenance

External Painting

Professional exterior painting of all surfaces to transform your home , outdoor space or commercial property improving kerb appeal and providing protection.

  • Masonry & render painting
  • Pebble-dash specialist
  • UPVC spraying
  • Weather-resistant coatings

Driveway Renewal

Complete driveway installation, restoration and sealing. Resin bound, tarmac, block paving and gravel driveway specialists.

  • Resin bound driveways
  • Block paving
  • Tarmac resurfacing
  • Driveway sealing

Pressure Washing

High-pressure cleaning for patios, driveways, paths, decking and more. Restore surfaces to like-new condition.

  • Patio & path cleaning
  • Re-sanding and re-sealing
  • Decking & fencing
  • Commercial cleaning
